data.title: Jeddah Hosts Opening Round of Nissan Tat3ees Championship's Second Season
data.content:
Jeddah, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The second season of the Nissan Tat3ees Championship will kick off today with its opening round in Jeddah, running for two days and featuring elite professional and amateur competitors.
    The championship is part of the 2026–2027 sports season, which will see the competition expand to several Saudi cities and other destinations across the Middle East.
    The opening round will feature competitors in multiple categories, including four-wheel-drive vehicles, motorcycles, and quad bikes, in contests designed to showcase participants' skills and abilities in dune-climbing motorsport.
    The championship will continue with its second round in Dammam on December 11 and 12, followed by rounds in the United Arab Emirates and Qatar. Saudi Arabia will host the final round in Hail in March 2027, where competitors will vie for the regional championship title.
    -- SPA
